name: Burlington
summary: Vermont's lakefront college town — a pedestrian marketplace, Lake Champlain sunsets, and one of the country's best folk-art museums.

lodging.name: A hotel near Church Street
lodging.blurb: Walkable to the marketplace and the waterfront.

foodMustTry.name: A Vermont farm-to-table dinner
foodMustTry.blurb: Local cheese, cider, and produce are the whole point here.

days.label: Day 50 — Church Street & the Waterfront
days.summary: The heart of Burlington and the lake at sunset.

item.title: Church Street Marketplace
item.blurb: A brick pedestrian mall of local shops, buskers, and cafés.

item.title: ECHO Leahy Center & the waterfront
item.blurb: A lake-ecology science center, then the waterfront path for a Champlain sunset behind the Adirondacks.

days.label: Day 51 — Shelburne
days.summary: One of America's great folk-art collections, on a lakeside farm.

item.title: Shelburne Museum
item.blurb: 39 buildings of Americana — quilts, carousels, a covered bridge, and a whole steamboat, the Ticonderoga, beached on the grounds.

item.title: Shelburne Farms
item.blurb: A model 1880s lakeside farm — cheddar, walking trails, and Adirondack views.

rest.label: An evening on Lake Champlain
rest.note: Church Street is closed to cars and the sunset goes down behind the Adirondacks across the water, which is the best free thing in Vermont. Nothing is scheduled after this.

days.label: Day 52 — South to Woodstock
days.summary: Down through the Green Mountains to Vermont's prettiest village.

commute.scenicNote: South along the spine of the Greens.
